title: Storm volume
description: A dense cloud turns slowly beneath a cold silver rim.
useCase: A focused atmospheric object for climate, film, and immersive storytelling.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. 36 density samples per pixel at a capped render resolution; illustrative lighting without multiple scattering.
look: A soft, wispy pale blue-grey cloud mass floating on a near-black slate-blue field, lit from the upper left with silvery highlights.
motion: The noise inside the raymarched cloud drifts slowly sideways, so its wisps churn and the mass appears to turn; a density slider thickens or thins it live.
adapt: The cloud is the `FRAGMENT` raymarcher: `volume` shapes it (`envelope` plus `layered` noise, drifting with `u_time*.045`), 36 steps accumulate light and `u_control` scales absorption. Tune those and the `light` colours; keep the fallback and reduced-motion still frame.
